summary.text: Thomas Beach is a Republican member of the South Carolina House of Representatives from District 10 and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election.
A real estate agent, he assumed office on November 14, 2022, succeeding West Cox.

paragraphs.text: Thomas Beach was born in Delta, Colorado, and lives in Piedmont, South Carolina.
He earned a bachelor's degree in political science from the University of North Alabama in 2013.
His career experience includes working as a real estate agent with Keller Williams Realty, an enrollment analyst with Prisma Health, and a district executive with Boy Scouts of America.
Beach assumed office in the South Carolina House of Representatives on November 14, 2022, and his current term ends on November 9, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists him on the Medical, Military, Public and Municipal Affairs Committee for 2025-2026.
He defeated Stewart Watson in the June 9, 2026, Republican primary and faces Democrat Thomas Stewart in the general election.
